data.text: Saad & Solla (1995) Fig. 1 — Over-realizable on-line learning in a soft-committee machine. A student with K = 3 hidden nodes learns from a teacher with M = 2 hidden nodes. Under on-line SGD (batch size 1, streaming inputs, N = 300), the generalization error exhibits a plateau — trapping in the symmetric subspace where all student nodes remain undifferentiated — before a transition onto specialization eliminates the redundant third node and drives the error toward zero. Teacher and readout weights are frozen; only the student's input-to-hidden couplings are adaptive.
